findings.title: Concurrency regression test does not wait for or synchronize the reader thread
findings.body: The reader thread is started and then discarded. The test immediately deletes all groups, sets `deletedAll`, and asserts `caughtExceptions` without joining the thread or waiting for it to execute a request while deletion is in progress. Consequently, the test can pass when the reader has not run yet, or when its final in-flight request fails after the assertion; it can also leave requests running into subsequent test cleanup. Retain the thread and coordinate it with latches/barriers so at least one read overlaps deletion, then join it before asserting collected failures.
